subject: Speculative enquiry, graduate civil designer, Werribee, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Tony,

This is a speculative enquiry, as I couldn't see a careers page on your site. I wanted to write to you directly because your Werribee office is close to me and your work is the kind I want to learn.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, documented in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. In 2019 and 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, handling site inspections, quality checks and progress reports. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

Your civil design for the 75-lot Coburns Road subdivision in Melton South caught my eye, since that is my own area. I haven't yet worked in an Australian design office or designed sewer and water reticulation, so I would start under supervision.

Would you be open to a short chat if a graduate design or drafting place comes up? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
